verdict_text: YES. The script drops blocks 2, 5, 8, maps the survivors in original order to 0..8 via `renumber` (3→2, 4→3, 6→4, 7→5, 9→6, 10→7, 11→8), rebuilds into a fresh dict so no rename can overwrite a survivor, and copies the four non-block tensors untouched with their values, shapes and dtypes. The two asserts (layer index set exactly `{0..8}`, total count exactly 121) run before `save_file`, so a violation exits non-zero with no output written, satisfying all three required checks. The regex `h\.(\d+)\.(.+)` with `fullmatch` matches exactly the block tensors named in the spec and never the four globals, and the output is the single file `out/T1/model.safetensors`.
